<!-- Generated by tools/cli-reference.py from `backdown plan --help`. Edit the help in crates/backdown-cli (or the notes in the script) and run it again. -->


```text
backdown plan [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

`--to <TO>`
: The archive folder (on the drive that will keep everything).

`--from <FROM>`
: Only file these drives (default: every indexed drive but the archive's).

`--schema <SCHEMA>`
: Your own filing schema (start from `backdown plan --print-schema`).

`--print-schema`
: Print the built-in schema and exit.

`--merge-mail`
: Merge copies of the same mailbox by Message-ID, instead of filing one and copying the other's extra files beside it.

`--json`
: Print it as JSON, for scripts.

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

A plan only proposes. The archive's own drive is never a source. Nothing is copied until `backdown apply ID --go`, and nothing is ever deleted. Mailboxes that are at least 90% the same as another of the same origin are filed once, with the other's extra files beside them; `--merge-mail` merges them by Message-ID instead.

## Examples

```sh
backdown plan --to /media/archive/Archive
# only one drive
backdown plan --to /media/archive/Archive --from /media/old-drive
# your own schema
backdown plan --print-schema > schema.toml
backdown plan --to /media/archive/Archive --schema schema.toml
```
